LESSON: DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: People, Population and Relationships
Topic 3.5: Diversity and Inclusion and interpersonal skills
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Diversity and Inclusion and interpersonal skills, part of People, Population and Relationships in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 8 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we demonstrate respect and appreciation of Social Cultural Diversity and Inclusion?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Diversity and Inclusion and interpersonal skills together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Patriotism: learners exhibit respect for fellow citizens as they discuss socio-cultural diversities in Kenya.

● Love: learners avoid inflicting emotional pain on others when roleplaying expressions of different emotions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Social cohesion: as learners work together harmoniously when role playing to express different emotions.

• Ethnic and Racial Relation: learners respect and acceptance of heterogeneity as they discuss personal and social cultural factors

that influence social cohesion.

Link to other Subjects:

English: learners use writing skills as they compose communication messages on social cultural diversities in Kenya.

Suggested Learning Resources:

digital devices, print resources, approved textbooks, signed audio visual clips,
